notes:
Build084 fixes overlapping deck boxes and restores the deck gallery's scrollable content size when a shared theme sets button height.

Build083 adds the animated mobile title with Arthur, Dracula and the Infinite Realities logo, plus Game Track 1 during matches. Implements the current 25 Ready entries, including the Greek mythology group. Update before starting new online matches.

Build082 shows all looked-at Search cards, improves selection of legal blockers, and adds screen fades and five music cues. Admin can preview, choose and retire animation and sound variations, and tune backgrounds and transitions in the interface editor.

Build081 adds the new default card back, per-deck card-back selection and an Admin library for publishing designs. The chosen back appears on deck stacks, concealed cards, the opponent’s hand and draw and shuffle animations.

Build080 adds live animation previews, per-animation switches and updated Energy, Refresh and Counterattack effects. Admin can publish animation choices for everyone. Older clients need the update to apply the switches.

Build079 adds a holographic finish option, clearer drag feedback and a 1.2-second hand preview hold. The match gear opens Match settings. Admin can save testing rules on-device or confirm a shared save through paired Card Studio.

Build078 adds drag-to-play and drag-to-move, clearer attack targets, in-range counterattacks after the hit, larger mobile hand and deck views, and a larger Search panel. Match settings remember optional drop confirmation and Search ordering. Both players should update before starting a new online match.

Build077 polishes the Android interface. Try the tutorial offline before signing in, recover from empty card searches, and check a deck while adding cards. Duels have clearer pile labels and more readable cards when artwork is unavailable. Includes updates to room setup, card inspection, and profile icon cropping.

Build076 adds the Christmas Reindeer, Captain Kidd, and revised Santa Claus and Scrooge. Includes 207 playable cards and 199 rendered images offline. Both players should update before starting a new online match.
